_README: SYNTHETIC EUR PRICES. NOT APPROVED, NOT REAL, NEVER LOAD THESE INTO list_prices.
Echo Barrier holds no approved EUR price list yet (live count on 2026-09-19: 0 active EUR
rows, 11 USD, 4 CAD). These numbers exist so the pricing engine can be proven before the
real ones land, and they are deliberately round so every expected total below can be
checked by hand in a few seconds.
THE RULE THIS FILE EXISTS TO SERVE: expected values come from here, never from the system
under test. A cross-check that reads the value it is checking checks nothing.
When Andrew or Geoff approve the real EUR list, this file does NOT change. It is the
engine's test fixture, not a staging copy of production pricing.

cap._why: max_discount_per_unit must exceed the largest unit-to-floor gap below (H8, 120.00), or urgent pricing is refused by checkDiscount rather than applied.

listPrices._why: An inactive row must be invisible to resolveBasePrice, so a price withdrawn from sale can never be quoted.
A real EUR row whose floor is null. Urgent pricing must refuse the whole cart rather than discount to nothing.
Same SKU, wrong currency. Must never be picked for a EUR cart.

typical_kit._why: The everyday shape: panels plus a fitting kit at one hook and two bungees per panel. The kit stays ONE line per component; splitting it is the bug that reached a real customer in September.

single_panel._why: Quantity of one. Rounding and per-unit maths have nowhere to hide.

panel_limit._why: Exactly 200 panels, the documented maximum, across two families. Allowed by the panel rule and OVER the 50000 amount ceiling, so it proves the two limits are independent.

floor_exact._why: A cash discount landing exactly ON the floor must be ALLOWED. Off-by-one here either blocks legitimate urgent quotes or lets them through a cent under.

one_cent_below_floor._why: The same line one cent lower must be REFUSED. This is the assertion that actually protects margin.

no_floor_row._why: Urgent pricing across a line whose floor is null must refuse the WHOLE cart, not silently price that line at list.

unpriced_sku._why: A SKU with no EUR row falls back to what the caller typed and is marked 'manual'. A discount on it must be refused: there is no list price to discount FROM.
